fullDescription: RecruiterAI is a luxury, high-end SaaS design system characterized by a deep 'Midnight' dark mode (#0a0e27) and sophisticated gold/amber accents (#d97706). It employs an editorial-style typography pairing of the Zodiak serif for headlines and Satoshi sans-serif for UI elements. The aesthetic leans heavily into glassmorphism, featuring backgrounds with 24px backdrop blurs, subtle mesh gradients, and refined 1px borders (rgba(255,255,255,0.06)). It is perfectly suited for premium fintech, executive recruitment platforms, high-end AI dashboards, and bespoke enterprise tools requiring a sense of prestige and authority.
prompt:
## Resumo
A bespoke, high-end dashboard design with a deep navy/midnight color palette, amber-gold accents, and editorial typography. It features glassmorphism cards, expansive whitespace, and sophisticated loading animations that convey a sense of 'neural' or high-tech processing.

## Estilo Visual
Create a luxury SaaS interface using a deep midnight background (#0a0e27) with a subtle radial mesh texture (2px dots at 40px intervals). 

**Typography:**
- Headlines: Zodiak Serif, font-weight 500, tracking-tight, white (#ffffff).
- Body/UI: Satoshi Sans-serif, tracking-wide, Slate-400 (#94a3b8).
- Accents: JetBrains Mono for technical micro-copy.

**Colors:**
- Primary Accent: Amber-600 (#d97706) to Amber-400 (#fbbf24) gradients.
- Borders: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06).
- Surface: Glassmorphic layers with background-blur (24px) and linear-gradients (145deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.03) 0%, rgba(255,255,255,0.01) 100%).

**Shadows:** 
- Large cards: 0 25px 50px -12px rgba(0,0,0,0.5).
- Buttons: 0 20px 40px rgba(217,119,6,0.2).

**Animations:**
- Fade-in: opacity 0 to 1 with 20px Y-axis translate over 0.8s using cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation Bar
Design a 96px high header with 80% opacity backdrop-blur-xl. Include a logo on the far left featuring a 40x40 gradient icon (#d97706 to #f59e0b) and serif text. Navigation links should use 14px Satoshi font with 2px bottom borders for active states. User profile section on the right with a circular avatar and stacked text: Name (white, uppercase, 12px) and Tier (amber, 10px, bold).

### Hero Header
Centered layout with 64px vertical spacing. Title: 64px Zodiak Serif, font-weight 500, white. Subtitle: 18px Satoshi, Slate-400, font-light, max-width 2xl, centered.

### Primary Interaction Card
A large container with 40px border-radius, 48px padding (p-12), and glassmorphism styling. Inside, place a full-width textarea with a 24px border-radius, dark transparent background, and 32px internal padding. Below the textarea, use a 2-column grid for inputs (Locations and Settings). All inputs should have 1px refined borders that glow gold on focus.

### Loading Modal Overlay
A full-screen overlay (#070a1a/95) with backdrop-blur-3xl. Features a central 160x160 circular progress ring with a 4px gold stroke (#d97706) and a pulsing central icon. Below the progress ring, display a vertical stack of 'Status Steps'—rounded cards with 10px bold status indicators (e.g., 'Awaiting', 'Processing', 'Verified') that change color from amber to emerald upon completion.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Elite Action Button — Oversized high-gloss primary button with deep shadows.
Build a button with h-20 (80px height), rounded-3xl (24px), using a linear gradient from #d97706 to #f59e0b. Text should be white, 20px, bold, uppercase with 0.1em tracking. Add a shadow: 0 20px 40px rgba(217,119,6,0.2). On hover, increase shadow intensity and scale to 1.02. On active, scale to 0.98.

### Neural Input Badge — Small status indicator for form fields.
A 10px font-size text element, bold, amber-500/60 color, uppercase tracking-widest, paired with a 2px x 2px amber glow dot to indicate 'active' or 'AI-powered' functionality.

### Status Step Card — Animated progress indicator card within the modal.
Create a 24px rounded card with 24px padding. Border: 1px solid white/5. Background: white/2%. Inactive state: 20% opacity. Active state: 100% opacity with #d97706 border-glow. Include a spinning icon (lucide:refresh-cw) for active states and a static check-circle for completed states.

style.description: The style is 'Luxury Tech', combining dark mode depth with warm gold highlights. Typography uses a high-contrast pairing: Zodiak (Serif) for elegance and Satoshi (Sans-serif) for functional clarity. Colors are anchored by Midnight Navy (#0a0e27), Amber (#f59e0b), and Gold (#d97706). Transitions are smooth, utilizing cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for a weighty, premium feel. Backgrounds include a subtle 40px grid mesh for texture.
